description: This file defines the JsonPipeDispatcher class, which manages JSON message communication over a pipe, including sending messages, closing the connection, handling received messages, and disposal logic.

classes.name: JsonPipeDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class that handles JSON pipe communication, emitting events, and managing lifecycle.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send a message through the JSON pipe and emit 'message' event.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the JSON pipe, emit 'close' event, and handle disposal.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Handle an incoming message object and emit a 'message' event.

methods.name: wasClosed
methods.description: Handle the event when the pipe is closed, emit 'closed' event with optional reason, and dispose.

ctags.name: JsonPipeDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class JsonPipeDispatcher extends Dispatcher<SdkObject, channels.JsonPipeChannel, LocalUti/
